ms.criteria:
The deliverables are considered “accepted” when they meet the following criteria.
・Community members including Milestone Reviewers can use the Extended Quadratic Funding platform in Production to:
・Log in and sign up
・Complete the KYB and KYC process
・Create, publish, and receive funds for a project
・Vote for projects
・Receive impact points and achievement badges
・Project close-out report includes all the obligatory fields of the close out report and is publicly available.
・Project close-out video walks through all the key points of the close-out report and is publicly available.
ms.report:
Dear Milestone Reviewers,
Thank you very much for your time, guidance, and valuable feedback throughout this journey. Based on your previous comments, we requested our engineering team to improve the test coverage and ensure clearer, more appropriate unit tests to demonstrate the platform's stability and functionality. Also we apologize for not making it clear that for the Gitbook guide that we previously provided, you were required to read via it progressively until you get to the point where it starts guiding you on how to use the platform from sign up onwards. We corrected the link to start directly from sign-up.
We equally apologize for the little detailed close out video we submitted, this was due to the fact that we were worried about the length of the video. The current version is more detailed.
In the close out video, activities like KYC can’t be done because this is the production site and it follows the rules put in place to prevent fraudulent activity and we can’t bypass that. Also voting period has not started officially so the production site can’t permit us to vote. Other aspects were demonstrated.
We also showed some of our KPI results in the video from our backend.
Please let us know if you need anymore information.
